avis.titre: Great for people who don't have acne
avis.texte: This product clears up all my pimples before they even form! Whenever I see that a blemish is about to form, I immediately put a small amount of the treatment on top of the affected area, and after 1 week of usage, the blemish was gone before it even formed. The only issue I've seen is that sometimes friends that have acne that I've reccomended this product see little to no results, so this might not work if you have anything other than occasional blemishes. avis.titre: The key to dried pimples and happier skin
avis.texte: When I first bought this, I wasn't sure it would work. I applied it to a pimple that night, and the next morning I woke up to find that it had not only shrunk in size but completely dried up. This stuff is powerful. You can use it instead of a pimple patch on smaller zits, or after using a pimple patch on larger ones. I will warn you to only use a small amount. As I said, it's a powerful treatment that will for sure dry the pimple, however if you use too much it can also cause a hard layer to form over the top of the pimple, trapping in fluid at the base. When used properly, I can assure you this stuff is magic and will work. Unless you have mean skin who doesn't like making friends with other treatments, THIS IS THE TREATMENT FOR YOU.
